Karakattakaran is a classic Tamil romantic drama film released in 1989 , directed by Gangai Amaran . The film stars Ramarajan and Kanaka in the lead roles, with music composed by the legendary Ilaiyaraaja , whose folk-based songs became timeless hits. The story revolves around Muthu , a humble and talented karakattam folk dancer , and his love story set against a rural backdrop filled with traditional culture, emotions, and social values. The film beautifully portrays village life, folk art, love, sacrifice, and human relationships. Karakattakaran is remembered as one of the most iconic rural Tamil films , especially for its music, dance sequences, and emotional storytelling. The movie achieved massive success and remains a favorite among Tamil cinema lovers even today.
